metadata.description: Read-only Workload Identity assessment. PRE-REQUISITE: a user-assigned managed identity exists in the target tenant and has been granted the 7 Microsoft Graph application permissions listed in the README. Pass that UAMI's resource ID + client ID as parameters.

Resource ID of an existing user-assigned managed identity that already has the 7 Microsoft Graph application permissions granted (see README). Format: /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/<name>
Client ID (application ID) of the same UAMI.
Lowercase alphanumeric prefix used to name the storage account and deployment script.
Azure region for storage + script. Defaults to the resource group region.
HTTPS base URL where the 01..09 PowerShell scripts can be downloaded from. MUST end with a trailing slash.
Optional SAS token (include leading '?') if the artifacts URL points to a private storage account.
Collection scripts to run. Default = all 8.
Forces re-execution of the deployment script on each redeploy. Default = current UTC time.

properties.scriptContent:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
Write-Host '== Workload Identity Assessment =='
Write-Host 'Tenant:' $env:TENANT_ID
Write-Host 'Storage:' $env:STORAGE '/' $env:CONTAINER
Write-Host 'Artifacts:' $env:ARTIFACTS_BASE

$tmp = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $env:TMP ('wia-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,8))) -Force
$scriptDir = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $tmp.FullName 'scripts') -Force
$outDir    = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $tmp.FullName 'output')  -Force

# Install required Microsoft.Graph submodules (Az is preinstalled in the deployment script container)
$gMods = @('Microsoft.Graph.Authentication','Microsoft.Graph.Identity.DirectoryManagement','Microsoft.Graph.Applications','Microsoft.Graph.Identity.Governance','Microsoft.Graph.Identity.SignIns','Microsoft.Graph.DirectoryObjects','Microsoft.Graph.Reports','Microsoft.Graph.Beta.Applications','Microsoft.Graph.Beta.Identity.Governance')
foreach ($m in $gMods) {
  if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name $m)) {
    Write-Host ("Installing module: " + $m)
    Install-Module -Name $m -Scope CurrentUser -Force -AllowClobber -Repository PSGallery
  }
}

# Connect using the deployment script's user-assigned identity
Connect-AzAccount -Identity -AccountId $env:UAMI_CLIENT_ID -Tenant $env:TENANT_ID -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
Import-Module Microsoft.Graph.Authentication -ErrorAction Stop
Connect-MgGraph -Identity -ClientId $env:UAMI_CLIENT_ID -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop
$ctx = Get-MgContext
Write-Host ("Connected to Graph as MI. Scopes: " + ($ctx.Scopes -join ', '))

$required = @('Application.Read.All','Directory.Read.All','Policy.Read.All','RoleManagement.Read.Directory','AuditLog.Read.All')
$missing = $required | Where-Object { $_ -notin $ctx.Scopes }
if ($missing) {
  Write-Warning ('UAMI is missing required Graph app roles: ' + ($missing -join ', ') + '. Grant them per the README, then redeploy.')
  throw 'Missing Graph app role assignments on the UAMI. See README.'
}

# Download scripts
$ids = $env:SCRIPT_IDS.Split(',') + @('09-html-report')
foreach ($id in $ids) {
  $url = $env:ARTIFACTS_BASE + $id + '.ps1' + $env:ARTIFACTS_SAS
  $dest = Join-Path $scriptDir.FullName ($id + '.ps1')
  Write-Host ("Downloading: " + $url)
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $dest -UseBasicParsing
}

# Run each collection script
foreach ($id in $env:SCRIPT_IDS.Split(',')) {
  $p = Join-Path $scriptDir.FullName ($id + '.ps1')
  Write-Host ("`n--- Running " + $id + " ---")
  try {
    & $p -OutputDir $outDir.FullName
  } catch {
    Write-Warning ($id + ' failed: ' + $_)
  }
}

# Build HTML report
$reportPath = Join-Path $tmp.FullName 'report.html'
& (Join-Path $scriptDir.FullName '09-html-report.ps1') -OutputDir $outDir.FullName -ReportPath $reportPath

# Upload + SAS
$stCtx = New-AzStorageContext -StorageAccountName $env:STORAGE -UseConnectedAccount
$blobName = 'report-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.html'
Set-AzStorageBlobContent -Context $stCtx -Container $env:CONTAINER -File $reportPath -Blob $blobName -Force -Properties @{ ContentType = 'text/html' } | Out-Null
$expiry = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().AddDays(7)
$sasUri = New-AzStorageBlobSASToken -Context $stCtx -Container $env:CONTAINER -Blob $blobName -Permission r -ExpiryTime $expiry -FullUri

# Also upload raw outputs as a zip
$zipPath = Join-Path $tmp.FullName 'raw-output.zip'
Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $outDir.FullName '*') -DestinationPath $zipPath -Force
$zipBlob = 'raw-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '.zip'
Set-AzStorageBlobContent -Context $stCtx -Container $env:CONTAINER -File $zipPath -Blob $zipBlob -Force | Out-Null
$zipUri = New-AzStorageBlobSASToken -Context $stCtx -Container $env:CONTAINER -Blob $zipBlob -Permission r -ExpiryTime $expiry -FullUri

$DeploymentScriptOutputs = @{
  reportUrl = $sasUri
  rawDataUrl = $zipUri
  expiresAt = $expiry.ToString('o')
  scriptsRun = $env:SCRIPT_IDS
}
Write-Host ("`nReport URL: " + $sasUri)
